notes.title: DEMO available!
notes.content:
Today we’re releasing the long-awaited DEMO version of LWT2: French confessions.


This version of the game is a huge improvement in comparison to the original:

we've upscaled the entire game from 1050x700 to 3840x2160 resolution—and it looks fantastic, both still images and animations

beyond the original content, you’ll get access to brand-new scenes, explicitly created for the French Confessions version of the game. These images are rendered natively in high resolution, using modern shaders and lighting. The animations are more advanced—and, frankly, hotter than ever. Expect a blend of nostalgic charm and fresh intensity. (some of the you’ll have a chance to witness in this demo)

re-build in RENPY with unlimited save slots, option to roll back the decisions and improved performance

new interface hints, pointing current locations of characters

So yes, it’s worth checking it out right now and adding French Confessions to your WISHLIST. We plan to release the full game later this year.



Let us know what you think about this demo version!
